description: Deterministic classification rules. Signal agent matches rules top-down; first match wins. No LLM here by design: error codes are a lookup problem, not a reasoning problem.
real_vocabulary_note: Rules 2-5 were authored against SYNTHETIC error codes using error_source='issuer'. Razorpay's live API emits 'bank' for the same concept: when we first fed real test-mode failures through Signal, both netbanking declines fell through to 'unclassified' (see the observed events in data/events.json). The 'bank' rules below were added from OBSERVED payloads only. Razorpay also documents 'business' and 'internal' as error_source values; we have not received either, so no rule guesses at them and they will land in 'unclassified' by design. NAMING LIMITATION: 'card_declined' is card-centric, but a bank-sourced netbanking decline is the same event - the customer's bank refused the instrument. The type name is kept for continuity with config/recovery_model.json rather than renamed the day before numbers were locked.
